properties.displayName: UAV S116 - Stabilization Loop Poisoning (Attitude Control Input Corruption)
properties.description: UAVTelemetry_CL(MsgType=ATTITUDE)에서 5분 구간별 RollSpeed_rads/PitchSpeed_rads/YawSpeed_rads의 표준편차가 임계값을 초과하는 자세제어 루프 발산(오염) 징후를 탐지. UAVOpmode_CL은 존재하지 않아 실제 자세 각속도 텔레메트리 기반으로 재구성. MITRE: T0835 Manipulate I/O Image (자세제어 루프 입력값을 조작해 기체 안정성을 저해)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let RateStdThreshold = 3.0; // rad/s 표준편차, 추후 조정
UAVTelemetry_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where MsgType == 'ATTITUDE'
| where isnotnull(RollSpeed_rads) and isnotnull(PitchSpeed_rads) and isnotnull(YawSpeed_rads)
| summarize StdRoll = stdev(RollSpeed_rads), StdPitch = stdev(PitchSpeed_rads), StdYaw = stdev(YawSpeed_rads), SampleCount = count()
    by UAVId, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where StdRoll > RateStdThreshold or StdPitch > RateStdThreshold or StdYaw > RateStdThreshold
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("자세제어루프_오염_변동성초과_", UAVId)
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, StdRoll, StdPitch, StdYaw, SampleCount, TriggerReason
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S116 - Stabilization Loop Poisoning (Attitude Control Input Corruption) - {{UAVId}}
